newsitem.title: UK: NatWest jumbo securitisation about to launch.
newsitem.headline: NatWest jumbo securitisation about to launch.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc's securitisation of around $5.0 billion of its corporate loan portfolio will be formally launched later this week, sources close to the deal said.
"As things look at the moment, today (Wednesday) we will firm things up for a launch on Thursday or Friday," a syndicate manager close to the deal said.
Natwest announced the securitisation on September 25 and has been extensively premarketing the offering since.
It said the move would release about 200 million stg of capital to the boost its balance sheet.
NatWest will transform corporate loans into dollar- and sterling-denominated FRNs and commercial paper in the Eurobond market as well as the U.S. rule 144A private placement market.
The deal will be launched by special purpose vehicle Rose Funding. Indicative pricing over three-month LIBOR):
